d: Pale ash blonde hair is styled in a thick center braid that flows into wavy, shoulder-length layers with blunt-cut bangs. The gold-colored eyes are narrow with a focused, neutral expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build is dressed in a dark brown laced bodice, a blue plaid pleated skirt, and dark grey thigh-high boots, all layered under a voluminous light taupe cloak fastened by a silver square buckle. A dark brown recurve bow is held in the hands, complemented by a brown leather utility belt with a silver buckle.
